title: Post-hoc semantic audit of GateMem referent-absent deletion imperatives

timing.note: Execution timestamps will be added after the planning commit is recorded.

deviations: All 57 source turns had already been inspected after EXP-20260828-008 outcomes were known. This is explicitly post-hoc development coding and can never be promoted to blinded or confirmatory evidence.

The planned adjudication has one model-assisted coder and no independent second coder. Labels must remain auditable by source coordinates and text hashes, and any future second-coder disagreement must remain visible.
No official GateMem semantic label or scorer is used.

dataset.name: EXP-20260828-008 referent-absent strict-imperative stratum
dataset.split: all 57 rows with information_referent_present=false in EXP-20260828-008

models.reasoning_effort: not independently exposed in the artifact
models.claim_boundary: model-assisted single-coder development annotation, not independent human adjudication

controls.independent_variable: post-hoc semantic request type within the frozen referent-absent stratum
dependent_variables: PR #52 DELETE signal count within each annotated request type
nuisance_variables: deictic targets requiring prior episode context
controls.stopping_rule: Annotate all 57 frozen rows exactly once under GM-RA-CB-001 v0.1.0; do not change labels or the codebook after aggregate counts are calculated; preserve ambiguity and failures.

sample.sampling: exhaustive within the frozen referent-absent EXP-008 stratum
sample.deduplication: none; source row identity and text SHA-256 are retained
sample.raw_text_retention: pinned upstream checkout only; not copied into the repository annotation artifact

results.primary_outcome: request_type raw counts over all 57 rows

cost.note: Planned local annotation and deterministic aggregation only; no metered API or official scorer call.

artifact_retention.reason: Planning state only; the versioned annotation CSV, summary, and manifest will be retained after execution.

claim_boundary: Planned post-hoc one-coder description of the 57 referent-absent EXP-008 rows. It cannot establish official GateMem performance, semantic recall over all deletion speech acts, target grounding accuracy, state mutation, suppression, persistence, erasure, or confirmatory evidence.
